description: Swapped the loop condition from AND (&&) to OR (||), which causes an infinite loop or premature exit when parameter lists differ in length.
Inverted the null check for otherParamType when thisParamType is null, misinterpreting cases where the other parameter has no type.
Accidentally advanced `otherParam` twice instead of advancing `thisParam` and `otherParam` respectively, breaking traversal.
Replaced the final reference equality check `thisParam == otherParam` with inequality `thisParam != otherParam`, returning incorrect boolean results for list length comparisons.
Negated the return value of checkEquivalenceHelper for the return type, causing equal return types to be treated as unequal.
